lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The police are literally at the door and you're telling me [beat] that the principal planted the flash drive in my locker?!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nix, listen to me, I didn't call them to get you arrested, [beat] I called them because Huda was blackmailing our entire family!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: It’s too late for explanations, because the moment those officers enter this room, [beat] Nix is the only one holding the stolen files.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: I’ve hacked the school's security cameras, but I can only loop the hallway footage [beat] for exactly sixty seconds before the system reboots!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Sixty seconds is not enough time to get past three squads of officers [beat] who are looking for a kid in a red hoodie!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Take my jacket and jump through the cafeteria window, [beat] but don't you dare lose that drive or we're all going to jail!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix knew he was running out of time; [beat] it was a race against a principal who had rigged the entire game against him.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You're not going anywhere, Nix, because Huda promised me a clean record [beat] if I made sure you stayed right here in this corner.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Get out of my way, Bruno, or I swear I will show everyone [beat] the video of you stealing the math final from Kamal’s office!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: He’s bluffing, you idiot, just grab the bag and hold him [beat] until the police reach the second floor landing!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The loop is breaking! Nix, you have five seconds to move [beat] or the cameras will catch you jumping out that window!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I’m taking the leap, but if I don't make it, [beat] tell Mom I found the file labeled Project Shadow under Huda's private folder!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix vanished into the night just as the door was kicked in, [beat] but he didn't realize who was waiting for him in the alleyway.
